## Review and RLS audit of T-036 (release check fixes, migration 0028)

Reviewer and RLS-auditor subagents, each without the implementer's context, on `git diff origin/main...agent/claude/T-036-release-fixes`.

| #   | Severity      | Finding                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Resolution                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| --- | ------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | High (both)   | A member confirms a held booking with an UPDATE (`status` PENDING → CONFIRMED), or moves confirmed dates onto another stay; the update policy only checks the account (gap since 0024, bypasses `auto_confirm` and institution approval too). | `booking_defaults` now runs `before insert or update`: a member's PENDING → CONFIRMED is refused (`admin_approval_required`), changed dates or guests re-run the hold, requester and cottage can't be changed by a member. Tests. |
| 2   | High (both)   | A member skips the hold with `requester_member_id = null` (the insert policy allows null).                                                                                                                                                    | A null requester from a plain member becomes their own booking before the check. Test.                                                                                                                                            |
| 3   | Medium (both) | A co-admin can demote the founder; then nobody can convert the account.                                                                                                                                                                       | `set_member_role` refuses (`founder_role_is_fixed`) unless the founder steps down themselves; shared helper `account_founder()`. Members page explains it. Test.                                                                  |
| 4   | Low-medium    | The guest limit summed every stay in the date range, not guests on the same night.                                                                                                                                                            | `overlap_peak_guests()` counts per night; the booking screen uses the same rule (`overlapPeakGuests`). Tests.                                                                                                                     |
| 5   | Low           | Client and database disagreed on zero-night stays.                                                                                                                                                                                            | Both now use nights [arrival, departure).                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| 6   | Low (UX)      | Hiding "Add a cottage" from members removed their way to "Create my own account".                                                                                                                                                             | Shown again for members as "Start my own cottage".                                                                                                                                                                                |
| 7   | Low           | `SignOutCleanup` relies on the persister's 1 s throttle (2 s timer); a sign-in within 2 s loses its fresh offline copy (rewritten on the next change).                                                                                        | Accepted. Comment placement in `__root.tsx` fixed.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| 8   | Low           | Older accounts: an unclaimed member row older than the real founder could make its claimer the "founder". Can't be triggered by an admin.                                                                                                     | Open: a data check in production (D-22).                                                                                                                                                                                          |

### Checked, no finding

No cross-account leak from the definer trigger (rows it reads are rejected by WITH CHECK with the same error); the overlap sum only covers bookings the caller can read; OWNER can't be assigned; the audit-log row has the right actor; helpers have no execute grant (allowlisted with reasons); `search_path` pinned.

### Not proven

PGlite with an auth shim, not real Supabase; the booking screen on a phone; production data for finding 8.
